_meta.note: DEMO DATASET. Rules are simplified from public scheme guidelines for hackathon use. Every scheme links to its official source; re-verify rules and amounts against the official source before relying on them (see 'verified_on').

schemes.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 per year in 3 instalments, directly to your bank account

rules.label: You do not pay income tax

steps: Visit pmkisan.gov.in and open 'Farmers Corner' > 'New Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar and mobile number, then fill land and bank details
Complete eKYC (OTP or at a CSC) and keep the registration number

schemes.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
schemes.benefit: Insurance cover for crop loss from drought, flood, pests and unseasonal rain, at a low farmer premium
schemes.benefit_hi: सूखा, बाढ़, कीट और बेमौसम बारिश से फसल नुकसान पर बीमा, किसान का प्रीमियम बहुत कम
documents: Land records or tenancy / sharecropping proof
steps: Apply through your bank, CSC or pmfby.gov.in before the cut-off date for the crop season
Pay the small farmer share of the premium
Report crop loss within 72 hours on the Crop Insurance app or helpline
schemes.deadline: Before each Kharif / Rabi sowing cut-off

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.benefit: Low-interest farm credit (interest subvention available for timely repayment)
schemes.benefit_hi: कम ब्याज पर खेती के लिए कर्ज (समय पर चुकाने पर ब्याज में छूट)
steps: Visit your bank branch or cooperative bank and ask for a KCC form
Submit the documents with the land details
Collect the card once approved

schemes.name: PM Kisan Maandhan (farmer pension)
schemes.benefit: ₹3,000 per month pension after age 60
schemes.benefit_hi: 60 वर्ष के बाद ₹3,000 प्रति माह पेंशन
steps: Visit the nearest CSC with documents
Choose a monthly contribution based on your age
Set up auto-debit and receive your pension account number

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.benefit: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospital treatment
schemes.benefit_hi: अस्पताल के इलाज के लिए परिवार को हर साल ₹5 लाख तक का स्वास्थ्य बीमा

any.label: Your household is in the BPL / SECC deprived category

steps: Check your name at pmjay.gov.in or at an empanelled hospital's Ayushman Mitra desk
Complete eKYC at a CSC or hospital help desk
Download or collect your Ayushman card

schemes.name: Free ration under NFSA / PMGKAY
schemes.name_hi: राशन (एनएफएसए / पीएम गरीब कल्याण अन्न योजना)
schemes.benefit: 5 kg free foodgrain per person per month
schemes.benefit_hi: प्रति व्यक्ति प्रति माह 5 किलो मुफ्त अनाज

rules.label: Household qualifies as BPL / priority household

steps: Apply for a ration card at your state food department portal or the local ration office
Link Aadhaar of all members
Collect grain from your fair price shop

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin
schemes.benefit: ₹1.2 lakh assistance (₹1.3 lakh in hilly / difficult areas) to build a pucca house, plus MGNREGA wages
schemes.benefit_hi: पक्का घर बनाने के लिए ₹1.2 लाख (पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में ₹1.3 लाख) की सहायता

rules.label: You live in a rural area
You do not own a pucca house
Your household is in the SECC / BPL deprived category

documents: Swachh Bharat toilet number if available
steps: Contact your Gram Panchayat to confirm you are on the PMAY-G permanent wait list
Submit documents and geo-tagging details
Receive instalments in your bank account as construction progresses

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0
schemes.benefit: Central assistance of up to ₹1.5 lakh for an urban house, or an interest subsidy on a home loan
schemes.benefit_hi: शहरी घर के लिए ₹1.5 लाख तक की केंद्रीय सहायता या होम लोन पर ब्याज छूट

rules.label: You live in an urban area
Your family does not own a pucca house
Annual household income up to ₹9 lakh

steps: Apply on pmaymis.gov.in or via your urban local body / CSC
Select the component (beneficiary-led construction, affordable housing, or credit-linked subsidy)
Track the application on the portal

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana (free LPG connection)
schemes.benefit: Free LPG connection (₹1,600 support) plus subsidy on refills for eligible households
schemes.benefit_hi: मुफ्त एलपीजी कनेक्शन (₹1,600 सहायता) और रिफिल पर सब्सिडी

rules.label: No existing LPG connection in the household

steps: Go to your nearest LPG distributor or apply at pmuy.gov.in
Fill the KYC form with Aadhaar and ration card details
Collect the connection after verification

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month from age 60
schemes.benefit_hi: 60 वर्ष के बाद ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 प्रति माह की निश्चित पेंशन

rules.label: You have a savings bank account
You are not an income tax payer

steps: Visit your bank or post office and ask for the APY form
Choose a pension amount; the monthly contribution depends on your age
Keep balance for auto-debit

schemes.name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
schemes.benefit: ₹2 lakh life cover for a premium of about ₹436 per year
schemes.benefit_hi: लगभग ₹436 सालाना प्रीमियम पर ₹2 लाख का जीवन बीमा

rules.label: You have a savings bank account

steps: Visit your bank or use net banking and sign the consent for auto-debit
Add a nominee
Renew annually by keeping balance in the account
schemes.deadline: Enrol by 31 May each year for the cycle; mid-year enrolment possible pro-rata

schemes.name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana
schemes.benefit: ₹2 lakh accidental death / full disability cover for ₹20 per year
schemes.benefit_hi: सिर्फ ₹20 सालाना पर ₹2 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा

rules.label: You have a savings bank account

steps: Visit your bank or use net banking / mobile banking
Consent to the ₹20 auto-debit
Add a nominee

schemes.name: e-Shram card (unorganised workers)
schemes.benefit: Universal Account Number, ₹2 lakh accident insurance (PMSBY) and access to future welfare schemes
schemes.benefit_hi: यूनिवर्सल अकाउंट नंबर, ₹2 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा और कल्याण योजनाओं का लाभ

rules.label: You work in the unorganised sector
You are not an EPFO / ESIC member
You are not an income tax payer

steps: Register for free at eshram.gov.in or at a CSC
Verify with Aadhaar OTP
Download your e-Shram card

schemes.name: PM Shram Yogi Maandhan (worker pension)
schemes.benefit: ₹3,000 per month pension after age 60
schemes.benefit_hi: 60 वर्ष के बाद ₹3,000 प्रति माह पेंशन

rules.label: You work in the unorganised sector
Monthly income up to ₹15,000 (₹1.8 lakh per year)
You are not an EPFO / ESIC / NPS member
You are not an income tax payer

steps: Visit the nearest CSC with Aadhaar and bank passbook
Pay the first contribution in cash
Receive your Shram Yogi pension card

schemes.name: PM MUDRA Yojana (business loan)
schemes.benefit: Collateral-free loans for small businesses (Shishu, Kishor, Tarun categories, up to ₹20 lakh in Tarun Plus)
schemes.benefit_hi: छोटे व्यवसाय के लिए बिना गारंटी कर्ज (शिशु, किशोर, तरुण श्रेणी)

rules.label: You run, or plan to run, a small non-farm business

steps: Apply at any bank, NBFC or MFI, or on udyamimitra.in
Choose Shishu, Kishor or Tarun based on loan size
Submit the business plan and KYC

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi (street vendor loan)
schemes.benefit: Working-capital loan starting at ₹10,000 with interest subsidy and digital-payment cashback
schemes.benefit_hi: ₹10,000 से शुरू होने वाला कार्यशील पूंजी कर्ज, ब्याज सब्सिडी के साथ
documents: Certificate of Vending / Letter of Recommendation from your urban local body
steps: Apply on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or at a CSC
Get the vending certificate or recommendation from your municipality if you don't have one
Receive the loan after bank approval

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma (artisans and craftspeople)
schemes.benefit: ₹15,000 toolkit voucher, skill training with ₹500/day stipend, collateral-free credit
schemes.benefit_hi: ₹15,000 का टूलकिट, ₹500/दिन वजीफे के साथ प्रशिक्षण, बिना गारंटी कर्ज

rules.label: You work in a traditional trade (carpenter, tailor, potter, blacksmith, etc.)

steps: Register on pmvishwakarma.gov.in via a CSC
Verification by Gram Panchayat / urban body and district committee
Training and toolkit issued after approval

schemes.name: MGNREGA (rural job guarantee)
schemes.benefit: Up to 100 days of guaranteed wage work per rural household per year
schemes.benefit_hi: ग्रामीण परिवार को साल में 100 दिन तक रोजगार की गारंटी

rules.label: You live in a rural area

steps: Apply for a Job Card at your Gram Panchayat
Submit a written request for work
Work is provided within 15 days, wages paid to your account

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension from the Centre (₹200 at age 60-79, ₹500 at 80+); most states add to this
schemes.benefit_hi: केंद्र से मासिक पेंशन (60-79 वर्ष ₹200, 80+ ₹500); कई राज्य अतिरिक्त राशि जोड़ते हैं
schemes.value_note: minimum central share
steps: Apply at your Gram Panchayat, ward office or state social welfare portal
Submit age and BPL proof
Pension is credited monthly after sanction

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension
schemes.benefit: Monthly pension (₹300 central share) for persons with severe disability
schemes.benefit_hi: गंभीर विकलांगता वाले व्यक्तियों के लिए मासिक पेंशन (केंद्र का हिस्सा ₹300)
schemes.value_note: central share

rules.label: You have a disability of 80% or more

steps: Get or confirm your UDID / disability certificate
Apply at your Gram Panchayat, ward office or state portal
Pension is credited monthly after sanction

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.benefit: High-interest, tax-free savings account for a girl child's education and marriage
schemes.benefit_hi: बेटी की पढ़ाई और शादी के लिए ऊंची ब्याज दर वाली टैक्स-फ्री बचत योजना

rules.label: You have a daughter under 10 years of age

steps: Visit any post office or authorised bank
Fill the account opening form, deposit minimum ₹250
Keep depositing (₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh per year)

schemes.name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
schemes.benefit: ₹5,000 maternity benefit in instalments for the first living child (plus ₹1,000 under JSY for institutional delivery)
schemes.benefit_hi: पहले बच्चे के लिए ₹5,000 मातृत्व लाभ किस्तों में

rules.label: You are pregnant or lactating (first living child)

steps: Register at your nearest Anganwadi Centre or health facility within the early weeks of pregnancy
Submit the application with documents
Instalments are credited to your account after each health milestone
schemes.deadline: Apply within 730 days of pregnancy for the later instalments

schemes.name: DAY-NRLM Self Help Groups (Lakhpati Didi)
schemes.name_hi: दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन (स्वयं सहायता समूह)
schemes.benefit: Revolving fund, low-interest bank loans and training for women's Self Help Groups
schemes.benefit_hi: महिला स्वयं सहायता समूहों के लिए रिवॉल्विंग फंड, कम ब्याज पर कर्ज और प्रशिक्षण

rules.label: You live in a rural area

steps: Contact your block / village livelihood mission office or an existing SHG
Join or form a group of 10-20 women
Open a group account and apply for the revolving fund and bank linkage

schemes.name: Stand-Up India
schemes.benefit: Bank loan of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for a new enterprise by SC/ST or women entrepreneurs
schemes.benefit_hi: एससी/एसटी या महिला उद्यमियों के लिए नए उद्यम हेतु ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक का ऋण

rules.label: You want to start a new business

steps: Register on standupmitra.in
Submit a business plan and choose a bank branch
Loan is processed by the bank

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC students
schemes.name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: Full or part course-fee reimbursement plus a monthly maintenance allowance
schemes.benefit_hi: पूरी या आंशिक फीस की वापसी और मासिक भत्ता

rules.label: You are a student after Class 10
You belong to the SC category
Annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh

steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Fill the application and upload documents
Get it verified by your institute, then by the nodal officer

schemes.name: Central Sector Scholarship for college students
schemes.name_hi: कॉलेज छात्रों के लिए केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: ₹12,000 per year for meritorious students from low-income families (₹20,000 at PG level)
schemes.benefit_hi: कम आय वाले मेधावी छात्रों के लिए ₹12,000 प्रति वर्ष

rules.label: You are a college / university student
Annual family income up to ₹4.5 lakh
You scored above the 80th percentile in Class 12

steps: Register on scholarships.gov.in
Fill the application and upload documents
Verify through your institute

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
schemes.benefit: ₹1,500 per month for eligible women (verify the current amount and status on the state portal)
schemes.benefit_hi: पात्र महिलाओं को ₹1,500 प्रति माह (वर्तमान राशि राज्य पोर्टल पर जांचें)

rules.label: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year
No income tax payer in the family

documents: Income certificate or yellow/orange ration card
steps: Apply through the Nari Shakti Doot app / state portal or your Anganwadi centre
Upload documents and bank details
Track approval on the portal
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Gruha Lakshmi (Karnataka)
schemes.benefit: ₹2,000 per month to the woman head of the family
schemes.benefit_hi: परिवार की महिला मुखिया को ₹2,000 प्रति माह

rules.label: Family does not pay income tax / GST

steps: Register through Seva Sindhu or at a Grama One / Bangalore One centre
Verify the ration card and bank details
Track your application status online
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (health cover for 70+)
schemes.name_hi: आयुष्मान वय वंदना (70+ के लिए स्वास्थ्य बीमा)
schemes.benefit: ₹5 lakh per year cashless hospital cover for every senior citizen aged 70+, whatever the income
schemes.benefit_hi: 70 वर्ष या उससे अधिक उम्र के हर बुज़ुर्ग को आय की परवाह किए बिना हर साल ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज
schemes.value_note: Cover is shared by the 70+ members of a family; it is separate from the regular Ayushman card.
steps: Visit pmjay.gov.in or download the Ayushman App and choose 'Vay Vandana card'
Verify with Aadhaar OTP (e-KYC) and submit the form
Download the card, or collect it at a CSC / empanelled hospital, and show it at admission

schemes.name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (zero-balance bank account)
schemes.name_hi: पीएम जन धन योजना (ज़ीरो बैलेंस बैंक खाता)
schemes.benefit: Zero-balance bank account with a RuPay card, ₹2 lakh accident cover and an overdraft facility
schemes.benefit_hi: ज़ीरो बैलेंस बैंक खाता, रुपे कार्ड, ₹2 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा और ओवरड्राफ्ट सुविधा

rules.label: You do not yet have a bank account

documents: Aadhaar card (or another officially valid ID)
steps: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra (business correspondent) near you
Ask for a PM Jan Dhan account and fill the one-page form
Collect the RuPay card and link Aadhaar and mobile for DBT benefits

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (rooftop solar)
schemes.name_hi: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ़्त बिजली योजना (छत पर सोलर)
schemes.benefit: Subsidy of up to ₹78,000 to install rooftop solar, and up to 300 free units of electricity a month
schemes.benefit_hi: छत पर सोलर लगाने पर ₹78,000 तक की सब्सिडी और हर महीने लगभग 300 यूनिट तक मुफ़्त बिजली
schemes.value_note: Subsidy: ₹30,000/kW up to 2 kW, ₹18,000 for the 3rd kW, capped at ₹78,000. You pay for the system first.

rules.label: Your family owns a house with a suitable rooftop

steps: Register on pmsuryaghar.gov.in with your state, electricity company and consumer number
Apply for rooftop solar and choose an approved vendor
After installation and inspection, the subsidy is credited to your bank account

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM (solar pumps for farmers)
schemes.benefit: Subsidy on solar irrigation pumps (central and state support, farmer pays the balance), plus income from surplus power
schemes.benefit_hi: सोलर सिंचाई पंप पर सब्सिडी (केंद्र और राज्य की मदद, बाकी किसान देता है) और बची बिजली से आमदनी

rules.label: You own or cultivate agricultural land

steps: Check your state's PM-KUSUM nodal agency or the pmkusum.mnre.gov.in portal
Apply online or at the agriculture / energy department office with your land details
Pay your share to the approved vendor; the pump is installed and inspected
schemes.deadline: Varies by state (check your state nodal agency)

schemes.name: PMEGP (subsidised loan to start a business)
schemes.name_hi: पीएमईजीपी (नया कारोबार शुरू करने के लिए सब्सिडी वाला ऋण)
schemes.benefit: Bank loan to start a new unit with a government subsidy of 15% to 35% of the project cost
schemes.benefit_hi: नया उद्यम शुरू करने के लिए बैंक ऋण, जिस पर परियोजना लागत का 15% से 35% तक सरकारी सब्सिडी
schemes.value_note: Subsidy depends on category and area: 15-25% general, up to 35% for SC/ST/OBC/women/rural applicants.

rules.label: You are unemployed, self-employed or an artisan

steps: Apply on the PMEGP e-portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal) with your project report
Attend the interview at the district task force; the application then goes to a bank
After the loan is sanctioned and the unit starts, the subsidy is credited to the loan account

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for ST students
schemes.name_hi: अनुसूचित जनजाति के छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: Course-fee reimbursement plus a monthly maintenance allowance for ST students after Class 10
schemes.benefit_hi: 10वीं के बाद पढ़ने वाले एसटी छात्रों को कोर्स फीस की वापसी और मासिक भत्ता

rules.label: You are a student after Class 10
You belong to the ST category
Annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh

steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Fill the application and upload documents
Get it verified by your institute, then by the nodal officer

schemes.name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship (OBC / EBC / DNT)
schemes.name_hi: पीएम यशस्वी पोस्ट मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति (ओबीसी / ईबीसी / डीएनटी)
schemes.benefit: Scholarship with academic allowance and fee support for OBC, EBC and DNT students after Class 10
schemes.benefit_hi: 10वीं के बाद पढ़ने वाले ओबीसी, ईबीसी और डीएनटी छात्रों को शैक्षणिक भत्ता और फीस सहायता

rules.label: You are a student after Class 10
You belong to the OBC category
Annual family income up to ₹2.5 lakh

steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Select PM YASASVI (OBC/EBC/DNT) post-matric and fill the application
Upload documents and get them verified by your institute

schemes.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship (girls in technical education)
schemes.name_hi: एआईसीटीई प्रगति छात्रवृत्ति (तकनीकी शिक्षा में छात्राएं)
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000 per year for girl students in AICTE-approved degree and diploma courses
schemes.benefit_hi: एआईसीटीई-मान्यता प्राप्त डिग्री और डिप्लोमा कोर्स में पढ़ने वाली छात्राओं को हर साल ₹50,000
schemes.value_note: Limited to one girl per family (two if the family has twin girls); the course must be AICTE-approved.

rules.label: Annual family income up to ₹8 lakh

steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Choose AICTE Pragati and fill in course and college details
Upload documents; the college verifies and forwards the application

schemes.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (cash for safe delivery)
schemes.name_hi: जननी सुरक्षा योजना (सुरक्षित प्रसव के लिए नकद सहायता)
schemes.benefit: Cash support for delivering in a government or accredited health facility (about ₹1,400 in rural low-performing states)
schemes.benefit_hi: सरकारी या मान्यता प्राप्त अस्पताल में प्रसव पर नकद सहायता (ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में लगभग ₹1,400)
schemes.value_note: Amount varies by state and by rural/urban area (₹600 to ₹1,400); check with your ASHA worker.
documents: JSY / MCP card from the ANM or ASHA
steps: Register the pregnancy with your ANM / ASHA worker or the nearest health centre
Deliver in a government or accredited private health facility
The cash is paid to your bank account after delivery; the ASHA worker helps with the paperwork

schemes.name: DDU-GKY (free skill training and job placement)
schemes.benefit: Free skill training with placement support for rural youth from poor families
schemes.benefit_hi: गरीब परिवारों के ग्रामीण युवाओं के लिए मुफ़्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण और नौकरी दिलाने में मदद

rules.label: You live in a rural area

steps: Find a DDU-GKY training centre on ddugky.gov.in or ask at your block office / SHG
Register and complete counselling at the centre
Finish the course and get placement support
schemes.deadline: Open all year (batches vary by training centre)

schemes.name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (free aids for poor seniors)
schemes.name_hi: राष्ट्रीय वयोश्री योजना (गरीब बुज़ुर्गों के लिए मुफ़्त सहायक उपकरण)
schemes.benefit: Free walking sticks, wheelchairs, hearing aids, spectacles and dentures for BPL senior citizens with age-related disability
schemes.benefit_hi: उम्र से जुड़ी कमज़ोरी वाले बीपीएल बुज़ुर्गों को मुफ़्त छड़ी, व्हीलचेयर, श्रवण यंत्र, चश्मा और नकली दांत
steps: Watch for an assessment camp near you or contact your district social welfare office
Get assessed at the camp with your BPL proof
Collect the aids at the distribution camp
schemes.deadline: Camps held through the year (ask your district office)

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
schemes.benefit: ₹1,500 per month directly to the bank account of eligible women
schemes.benefit_hi: पात्र महिलाओं के बैंक खाते में हर महीने सीधे ₹1,500
schemes.value_note: For married, widowed, divorced and abandoned women. Amount raised to ₹1,500 from Nov 2025; re-check on the state portal.

rules.label: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year
No income tax payer in the family

steps: Contact your Anganwadi centre, ward / gram panchayat office or the cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in portal
Submit the form with Samagra ID and bank details
After verification the money comes to your bank account around the 10th of each month
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Deen Dayal Lado Lakshmi Yojana (Haryana)
schemes.benefit: ₹2,100 per month for eligible women (under the 2026 rules part of the amount goes into a savings deposit)
schemes.benefit_hi: पात्र महिलाओं को हर महीने ₹2,100 (2026 के नियमों के अनुसार कुछ राशि बचत जमा में जाती है)
schemes.value_note: Rules were revised in 2026 (compulsory savings component, wider eligibility); confirm the current split on the official app.

rules.label: Family income below ₹1 lakh per year

steps: Apply through the official Lado Lakshmi mobile app or your nearest Saral / CSC centre
Enter family ID and bank details and submit
After approval, complete monthly face authentication to keep receiving payments
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Subhadra Yojana (Odisha)
schemes.benefit: ₹10,000 per year in two instalments of ₹5,000 (₹50,000 over five years) to eligible women

rules.label: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year
No income tax payer in the family

documents: Odisha domicile / ration card (NFSA or SFSS)
steps: Apply at your Mo Seba Kendra / Jana Seva Kendra or on the Subhadra portal
Submit Aadhaar, ration card and bank details
Instalments of ₹5,000 are credited in two rounds each year (around Raksha Bandhan and Women's Day)
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana (Bihar)
schemes.benefit: ₹10,000 seed money to start a small business, with up to ₹2 lakh more later for those who use it well
schemes.benefit_hi: छोटा कारोबार शुरू करने के लिए ₹10,000 की शुरुआती मदद, अच्छे उपयोग पर आगे ₹2 लाख तक की सहायता
schemes.value_note: Launched Sept 2025; one woman per family. Check whether new enrolment is open before applying.

rules.label: No income tax payer in the family

documents: JEEViKA self help group membership details
steps: Join or contact your local JEEViKA self help group (Jeevika Didi) or the block office
Apply on the MMRY portal with your Aadhaar and bank details
The ₹10,000 is paid by DBT; follow the block office guidance for the next-stage support
schemes.deadline: Enrolment phases vary - check with JEEViKA / block office

schemes.name: Delhi Lakshmi Yojana (Delhi)
schemes.benefit: ₹2,500 per month for eligible women from lower-income households (part of it is reported to go into a savings deposit)
schemes.benefit_hi: कम आय वाले परिवारों की पात्र महिलाओं को हर महीने ₹2,500 (रिपोर्ट के अनुसार इसका कुछ हिस्सा बचत जमा में जाता है)
schemes.value_note: Launched 26 Aug 2026 (earlier called Mahila Samriddhi Yojana). Reports say only part of the ₹2,500 is paid in cash; confirm the split.

rules.label: Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh per year
No income tax payer in the family

steps: Register on the Delhi government's Women & Child Development portal or at a registration camp
Fill in identity, residence and family-income details
Track approval and payment on the portal
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Maiyan Samman Yojana (Jharkhand)
schemes.benefit: ₹2,500 per month to eligible women
schemes.benefit_hi: पात्र महिलाओं को हर महीने ₹2,500
schemes.value_note: Sources disagree on the exact age floor (18 vs 21) and family-income ceiling; the state portal is the final word.

rules.label: No income tax payer in the family

steps: Register at the camp, block office or the mmmsy.jharkhand.gov.in portal
Submit Aadhaar, ration card and bank details
Keep your bank account Aadhaar-linked to receive the monthly transfer
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Mahtari Vandan Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
schemes.benefit: ₹1,000 per month to eligible married, widowed, divorced and abandoned women
schemes.benefit_hi: पात्र विवाहित, विधवा, तलाकशुदा और परित्यक्ता महिलाओं को हर महीने ₹1,000
schemes.value_note: For married, widowed, divorced and abandoned women; those in government service or paying income tax are excluded.

rules.label: No income tax payer in the family

steps: Apply at your Anganwadi centre, ward / gram panchayat office or mahtarivandan.cgstate.gov.in
Submit the form with Aadhaar and bank details
The monthly amount is credited by DBT after approval
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Orunodoi 3.0 (Assam)
schemes.benefit: ₹1,250 per month to the woman of an eligible low-income family (additional LPG support has been announced)
schemes.benefit_hi: कम आय वाले पात्र परिवार की महिला को हर महीने ₹1,250 (एलपीजी के लिए अतिरिक्त मदद की घोषणा भी हुई है)
schemes.value_note: One woman per family. The state announced no income certificate is needed; exact income ceiling differs across sources.

rules.label: No income tax payer / government employee in the family

steps: Beneficiaries are enrolled through your gram panchayat / ward or ULB; ask the local office for the enrolment drive
Fill the form with ration card and bank details
Money arrives in the woman's bank account on the 1st of each month
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Rajasthan Rasoi Gas Cylinder Subsidy Yojana
schemes.name_hi: राजस्थान रसोई गैस सिलेंडर सब्सिडी योजना
schemes.benefit: LPG cylinder at ₹450 for eligible families (one per month, subsidy paid by DBT)
schemes.benefit_hi: पात्र परिवारों को ₹450 में एलपीजी सिलेंडर (हर महीने एक, सब्सिडी डीबीटी से)
schemes.value_note: Covers PM Ujjwala families, BPL families and NFSA families; the site check here uses BPL as a proxy.

rules.label: BPL / NFSA family (BPL status used as the check)
Your home has an LPG connection

documents: Ration card (NFSA / BPL) or Ujjwala proof
steps: Make sure your LPG ID is mapped with Jan Aadhaar (ask your gas agency)
Register if asked (many families are enrolled automatically)
Pay the market price when you book; the subsidy is returned to your bank account
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Gruha Jyothi - free electricity (Karnataka)
schemes.benefit: Free electricity up to 200 units a month for household consumers (zero bill)
schemes.benefit_hi: घरेलू उपभोक्ताओं को हर महीने 200 यूनिट तक मुफ़्त बिजली (ज़ीरो बिल)
schemes.value_note: The state has said it will review beneficiaries via a house-to-house survey; check current rules.
documents: Proof of residence / rent agreement (if a tenant)
steps: Register on Seva Sindhu or at a Grama One / Bangalore One centre with your electricity account number
Link Aadhaar to your connection if asked
The zero bill is applied automatically each month
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Shakti - free bus travel for women (Karnataka)
schemes.name_hi: शक्ति - महिलाओं के लिए मुफ़्त बस यात्रा (कर्नाटक)
schemes.benefit: Free travel on regular state-run buses (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, KKRTC) for women who live in Karnataka
schemes.benefit_hi: कर्नाटक की महिलाओं के लिए सरकारी साधारण बसों (केएसआरटीसी, बीएमटीसी आदि) में मुफ़्त यात्रा
schemes.value_note: The state is moving to smart-card passes for Karnataka residents; check what is required on the day you travel.
documents: Aadhaar card or any government ID showing Karnataka residence
steps: Get the Shakti smart card from Seva Sindhu (where the state is issuing passes)
Show your ID or card to the conductor and collect a zero-fare ticket
Not valid on luxury, AC or inter-state buses
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Yuva Nidhi - unemployment allowance (Karnataka)
schemes.benefit: ₹3,000 per month for unemployed graduates and ₹1,500 for diploma holders, for up to 2 years
schemes.benefit_hi: बेरोज़गार स्नातकों को ₹3,000 और डिप्लोमा धारकों को ₹1,500 प्रति माह, अधिकतम 2 साल
schemes.value_note: Meant for recent graduates and diploma holders who have not found a job within 6 months. Amount depends on the qualification.
documents: Karnataka residence proof (6 years of study or residence)
steps: Apply on Seva Sindhu after completing your degree or diploma
Upload certificates and bank details
Declare each month that you are still unemployed to keep receiving the allowance
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Annadata Sukhibhava - PM Kisan (Andhra Pradesh)
schemes.benefit: ₹20,000 per year for eligible farmers in 3 instalments: ₹14,000 from the state plus ₹6,000 PM-KISAN
schemes.benefit_hi: पात्र किसानों को हर साल ₹20,000, तीन किस्तों में: राज्य के ₹14,000 और पीएम-किसान के ₹6,000
schemes.value_note: ₹14,000 is the state's top-up; the ₹6,000 PM-KISAN part is already counted under PM-KISAN, so it is not added again here.

rules.label: No income tax payer in the family

steps: Register or verify your name at your Rythu Seva Kendra (RSK)
Complete eKYC and make sure your land and bank details are correct
Instalments of ₹7,000, ₹7,000 and ₹6,000 are credited through the year
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
schemes.benefit: ₹25,000 in six stages for a girl child, from birth through graduation
schemes.benefit_hi: बेटी के जन्म से लेकर स्नातक तक छह चरणों में कुल ₹25,000
schemes.value_note: Applies to girls born on or after 1 April 2019; up to two girls per family (twins count as one birth). The 'daughter under 10' answer is only an approximation.

rules.label: You have a daughter born on or after 1 April 2019
Family income up to ₹3 lakh per year

documents: Aadhaar card of mother / father and the girl
steps: Register on the Kanya Sumangala portal (mksy.up.gov.in) for the stage your daughter is at
Upload documents and submit
Money for each stage (birth, vaccination, Class 1, 6, 9 and 12/graduation) is paid by DBT
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status

schemes.name: Lek Ladki Yojana (Maharashtra)
schemes.benefit: ₹1,01,000 in stages for a girl child, from birth to age 18
schemes.benefit_hi: बेटी के जन्म से 18 वर्ष की उम्र तक चरणों में कुल ₹1,01,000
schemes.value_note: For girls born on or after 1 April 2023. The 'daughter under 10' answer is only an approximation of the birth-date rule.

rules.label: You have a daughter born on or after 1 April 2023
Family income up to ₹1 lakh per year (yellow / orange ration card)

steps: Apply through your Anganwadi centre or the state WCD portal for the stage your daughter is at
Submit documents (birth certificate, ration card, income proof)
Payments are made at birth, Class 1, Class 6, Class 11 and at 18
schemes.deadline: Check state portal for current status
